issues.title: Make two-tier gate workflow, bounded review, and effort defaults normative in skills
issues.dod: Skill and workflow text makes normative: fast gate for iteration and full gate at exactly the final task head and story integration (D1); one comprehensive review, parallel perspectives aggregated, one consolidated remediation, hard-scoped confirmation with critical-severity escape, cap of 3 cycles then human escalation (D5); medium effort default with planning-time high assignment and auto-escalation at remediation cycle 2, transcript-free dispatch, evidence-based gate acceptance rule (D6, D4 acceptance text).
notes: Text-only task: pays off on the next story before any tooling lands.
Reviewer chat output contract: rating + actionable findings only; full assessment JSON to a file under .armature/review/, referenced by path.
Acceptance rule text: gate criterion satisfied iff evidence op has exit=0, profile=full, SHA == bundle head; otherwise rerun, never indeterminate.

issues.title: Add make check-fast with diff routing; single-run test/coverage in full gate
issues.dod: make check-fast routes deterministically from git diff against merge-base HEAD origin/main (BASE= override): Go changes run lint+build+tests for changed packages plus reverse importers; skills/docs-skills changes run skill/doc validation; cmd or census-surface changes run census-drift-check; docs-only changes run adr-principles only. The full gate runs the unit suite once with -coverprofile and the coverage threshold reads that profile instead of re-running tests.
notes: Routing must be deterministic from repo state alone (I5); no worker judgment about which tests matter.
test-check-fast.sh follows the test-census-drift-check pattern: verify routing for a doc-only diff, a cmd flag diff, and an internal package diff with a cmd reverse importer.
acceptance: scripts/test-check-fast.sh passes: doc-only diff runs no mutate, coverage, or crosscompile
scripts/test-check-fast.sh passes: cmd flag diff routes census-drift-check plus cmd package tests

issues.title: Gate evidence: config-declared profiles, arm gate run, evidence ops in review bundle
issues.scope: internal/config/config.go, internal/config/config_test.go, internal/ops/gate_evidence.go (new), internal/ops/gate_evidence_test.go (new), cmd/armature/gate.go (new), cmd/armature/gate_test.go (new), internal/review/bundle_evidence.go (new), internal/review/bundle_evidence_test.go (new), docs/commands.md, docs/design/surface-census.md
issues.dod: Config gains a gates map ({name: {command: []string}}) with profile name 'full' reserved as the publish profile. arm gate run <profile> executes the configured command, streams output to a log file, and appends an evidence op (profile, command, head SHA, start, end, exit) to the invoking worker's own log; a dirty tree records the run as uncommitted/uncitable; unconfigured repos get a clear error. ReviewBundle includes gate evidence ops so reviewers can cite them.
notes: Armature ships no toolchain knowledge: profiles are repo config, like hooks (product-boundary decision from grilling).
Evidence op is written by the process that observed the exit status; self-report never counts.
Vertical slice: docs/commands.md entry and surface-census.md rows for arm gate land in this task.
